delphi_nhsn_covid.long_name: Number of COVID hospitalizations in the National Healthcare Safety Network
delphi_nhsn_covid.short_description: Weekly count of COVID-19 associated hospital admissions reported to CDC's NHSN.
delphi_nhsn_covid.long_description: The National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) is the nation's most widely used healthcare-associated infection tracking system. This dataset reports preliminary and finalized weekly hospital respiratory data and metrics aggregated to national and state/territory levels. Values are available for reference dates beginning August 2020. HHS collects data from state and territorial health departments about many, but not all, hospitals in the U.S. Notably excluded from this dataset are psychiatric and rehabilitation facilities, and religious non-medical facilities. Reporting was voluntary from May 1 to October 31, 2024, so participation dropped in some states during those weeks (for example, Texas reported only 4-15 admissions per week in September 2024) and national totals for that period are not comparable with the mandatory-reporting periods before and after it.

delphi_nhsn_flu.long_name: Number of influenza hospitalizations in the National Healthcare Safety Network
delphi_nhsn_flu.short_description: Weekly count of influenza-associated hospital admissions reported to CDC's NHSN.
delphi_nhsn_flu.long_description: The National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) is the nation's most widely used healthcare-associated infection tracking system. This dataset reports preliminary and finalized weekly hospital respiratory data and metrics aggregated to national and state/territory levels. Values start with the week ending November 2, 2024, when hospital reporting of influenza admissions became mandatory; earlier weeks of voluntary reporting had incomplete hospital participation and are excluded. HHS collects data from state and territorial health departments about many, but not all, hospitals in the U.S. Notably excluded from this dataset are psychiatric and rehabilitation facilities, and religious non-medical facilities.

delphi_nhsn.name: CMU Delphi Epidata - NHSN Respiratory Hospitalizations
delphi_nhsn.organization: Carnegie Mellon University Delphi Research Group
delphi_nhsn.description: Weekly hospital respiratory data reported to CDC's National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN), accessed via the CMU Delphi Epidata API. NHSN is the nation's most widely used healthcare-associated infection tracking system, collecting data from hospitals across the United States. The data includes COVID-19, influenza, and RSV associated hospital admissions aggregated to national, state, and territory levels. Hospital reporting was mandatory through April 2024, voluntary from May 1 to October 31, 2024 (with variable participation), and mandatory again from November 1, 2024. COVID-19 admissions are published from August 2020; influenza and RSV admissions are published only from the week ending November 2, 2024. Until September 2026 PopHIVE read these signals from Delphi's legacy COVIDcast endpoint, which stopped updating after the week ending September 12, 2026; they are now read from the Epidata v5 API.
delphi_nhsn.restrictions: CC-BY Attribution license. Data may be used with attribution to the CMU Delphi Group and CDC NHSN.
